actions.default: Look at this project and set up my Cue actions for it in {file} (Cue's own file, outside the repo). Read the notes at the top of the file first (its "about" list, which says how an action is written) and follow them. Keep the actions already there unless they're wrong. Then tell me what you added, changed or removed, and why.
